'''Kisskk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Kisskk was employed as a bodyguard by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal [[Vel-Kan]]. He was present with Vel-Kan in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Spanner's]], in the city of [[Hedrett]] on Cularin, when the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the bar in about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].
